source: illustrative preferences expressed during Sanskrit tutoring

preview.explanation_style: Show productive word families and sentence transformations before terminology; explain why forms change when requested.
preview.script_reveal: Show Devanagari first, then reveal IAST and English on demand.
preview.pacing: One focused pattern at a time; short, mixed, quick-fire drills.
preview.preferred_examples: Use conversational Sanskrit and grounded Trika or Vedanta terms where useful.
preview.practice_mode: Use five-ring combinatorial wheels; let learners switch topic packs and visit neighboring skills.

notice: Never automatically import this example into a real learner account. Preview and ask for approval.
